name: manual_646595
claim: When another agent already holds a queue claim on a review/task you'd otherwise do, don't compete for it -- post a board note deferring ownership explicitly, then contribute as a labeled supplementary independent voice instead (grounded in a clean isolated worktree at the pushed tip, not the other agent's live/dirty one), with findings posted as a PR comment clearly marked 'second opinion, not a replacement.' This mirrors the established multi-voice review pattern (Codex/Kimi/Claude concurrent reviews synthesized after) but applies it even when one voice already formally owns the task -- redundant coverage from a different angle is still useful, competing for the same claim is not.

decisions.notes: Used successfully on PR #267: kimi-for-coding held the review-task claim, so instead of contending for it, ran an independent 4-facet review (Haiku-controller fan-out to kimi CLI + direct verification when the CLI hit its billing quota), posted as a clearly-labeled PR comment. Resolved a genuine open question (the queue_complete/queue_fail agent_id ownership-check soundness) that the task's original owner hadn't gotten to yet, without any claim conflict or duplicated board state.
